name: Boluo
source: Boluo County Real Estate Registration Center, under the Huizhou/Boluo Natural Resources authority, is evidenced by official registration notices and the official Huizhou map-inquiry service announcement; no anonymous parcel geometry service was verified.

queries.query: Boluo County China cadastral parcel map official natural resources land registration map
queries.result: Found the official Huizhou Natural Resources announcement for the citywide real-estate map inquiry service and the official Boluo government registration-center notice. officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Boluo County Real Estate Registration Center / Huizhou Boluo Natural Resources Bureau
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official 2026 registration notice names the Boluo County Real Estate Registration Center, gives its service-center address and contact channels, and publishes a land-right registration notice. This establishes a local registry custodian but publishes no parcel geometry or safe native parcel ID.

Official announcement describes the public “以图查房” map service for real-estate registration information, cadastral maps and house-unit maps. It is accessed through the bureau WeChat account and requires identity verification/facial recognition before map inquiry.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Guangdong Government Services Network / Boluo County service portal
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official regional portal lists “不动产登记资料查询” as a service. The inspected public page exposes service discovery, not an anonymous parcel feature endpoint.
